digest.component_or_area: LLM provider resolution and OpenAI-compatible endpoint routing
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model constructs targets using the ambiguous openai: prefix because v2 will reinterpret it from Chat Completions to Responses
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target both preserve or emit the ambiguous openai: qualifier for inferred and fallback OpenAI targets, triggering the deprecation warning at runtime

ProviderSession's cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override gates match only the legacy openai provider name, causing custom-endpoint routing to fail when targets are explicitly qualified with openai-chat:

Normalizing all inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to openai-chat: preserves the existing Chat Completions wire protocol and custom-endpoint compatibility while eliminating the announced v2 deprecation warning
The user approved preserving Chat Completions semantics and explicitly adopting openai-chat: as the stable contract, with deliberate migration to openai-responses: tracked separately
